items.text: Responsible for the development of Pegasus, our next-generation massively parallel physical verification system, with focus on the Fill and DRC product development and foundry enablement.
Performs as individual contributor on case analysis, problem solving, validation and documentation.
Working closely with PE and QPV for the DRC/FILL deck developing and QC pattern generation.
Solid background in computational geometry and graph algorithm.
Some knowledge on the foundry qualification of EDA tool is preferred.
Good English reading and writing skills.

description.text:
Position Description
-Responsible for the development of Pegasus, our next-generation massively parallel physical verification system, with focus on the Fill and DRC product development and foundry enablement.
-Performs as individual contributor on case analysis, problem solving, validation and documentation.
-Working closely with PE and QPV for the DRC/FILL deck developing and QC pattern generation.
Requirements
-Solid background in computational geometry and graph algorithm.
-Excellent programming skill in C/C++/Python.
-Some knowledge on the foundry qualification of EDA tool is preferred.
-Good English reading and writing skills.
-Good communication skills.
